messages:
jordan_customer: Hi, our March invoice shows 12,124 tokens billed but our client-side SDK estimator reports 8,390. We didn't change prompts. Can you help?

anna_support: Sorry about that — can you share a request_id for one sample request and a short convo snippet? Also which SDK version?

jordan_customer: request_id: r-8f34c7a2. sample convo attached:
```
[system] You are an assistant.
[user] Summarize this dataset in 2 bullets.
```
Using node SDK v1.4.1, estimator output: prompt 42 tokens, completion 98 tokens -> ~140 total per call.

anna_support: thanks. Can you also paste the exact HTTP payload you sent (headers + body) and the timestamp? we'll pull server usage logs.

jordan_customer: sent at 2026-03-09T17:22:11Z. payload:
```
{ "model":"redwood-1-small", "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize..."}], "max_tokens":150 }
```

opsbot: [system] Ingested request r-8f34c7a2 by prod-router-2 at 2026-03-09T17:22:11Z

anna_support: pulled the server usage for r-8f34c7a2 — server shows billed_prompt: 76, billed_completion: 124, total_billed: 204. That's ~64 tokens higher than SDK estimate. Escalating to billing + infra to explain delta. @mike_billing @sophia_infra

mike_billing: looking now. Quick note: invoices include some aggregation overhead for batched requests and hidden system tooling tokens (e.g., internal prompt wrappers) that are not surfaced by client tokenizers. Can you check for function/tool traces in the response?

jordan_customer: no function calls in this request. I do see in the raw server response an extra system message I didn't include: "[internal] provenance: sandbox-v2" — I didn't add that.

sophia_infra: that's the likely cause. We inject a short provenance system marker and occasionally a routing header message for safety checks. Those add tokens. SDK estimator uses local tokenization of the user-visible messages only, so it undercounts.

anna_support: reproduction steps for engineers:
1) Send the payload above via SDK and record local estimator.
2) Fetch /v1/requests/:id/usage on the control plane to get authoritative billed tokens.
3) Compare — you'll see system/provenance + routing messages + trailing EOS accounted server-side.

anna_support: short term workaround: use the server /usage endpoint for billing reconciliation. We're updating the SDK to optionally include server-inserted system messages in the local estimator.

mike_billing: assigned BILL-742 to sync counting rules. ETA: patch to billing calc docs and SDK flag by 2026-03-20. We'll also add a line on invoices that server-side overhead may apply.

jordan_customer: thanks — appreciate the quick triage. Please ping when patch lands.

anna_support: will do. marking resolved for now, will reopen if numbers don't align after SDK update. :thumbsup:
